design.carrier: Actual 48 kbps AAC in MP4 with copied H.264 pictures, continuous decoded audio. PCM comparator reuses original adapted picture and single spoken excerpt.
design.controls: Prior schedule plus same-clock picture and sound, repeated bed, and matched -5 dB independent speech added to both shifts, the synchronized controls and untouched speech. Synchronized pictures are retimed, encoded, decoded and measured on their delivery clock.
design.decision: Extra evidence is justified for a later product trial only with at least two added clean AAC pairs from distinct recordings, no added ordinary flags in either carrier and no synchronized or global flags in the candidate. No coverage or adoption inference is drawn from the three unseen speakers.
